note: 2022 evidence file consolidates direct research and previously completed legacy-master evidence. Duplicate/context rows remain in the reconciliation file rather than being promoted to independent canonical events.

events.title: DeFi TVL collapses during bear market
events.summary: DeFi total value locked contracted sharply through 2022. DefiLlama-based year-end research places TVL near $42 billion after beginning the year around $166 billion, a decline of roughly three quarters.
events.significance: The contraction quantified the unwinding of DeFi leverage through the Terra, CeFi and FTX shocks and marked the end of the 2020-21 expansion cycle.

sources.title: The Block Research — Biggest DeFi Trends in 2022

events.notes: Era-level quantitative market event; exact TVL values vary with methodology and chain/protocol inclusion.

events.title: India introduces major crypto tax rules
events.summary: India's 2022 tax framework created specific rules for virtual digital assets, including a 1% tax deduction at source on covered transfers under Section 194S.
events.significance: The framework formalized crypto taxation in India while imposing transaction-level reporting/withholding friction.

sources.title: India Income Tax Act Section 194S — virtual digital asset withholding

events.notes: Add the separate 30% income-tax provision once the exact official Section 115BBH source is attached.

events.title: Netflix releases QuadrigaCX documentary Trust No One
events.summary: Netflix released the documentary Trust No One: The Hunt for the Crypto King in 2022, not 2021, revisiting QuadrigaCX and the death of founder Gerald Cotten.
events.significance: The documentary demonstrates how Quadriga became true-crime culture beyond the crypto industry.

sources.title: Netflix — Trust No One: The Hunt for the Crypto King

events.title: STEPN token economy booms and crashes
events.summary: STEPN's monthly active users rose from about 2,500 in January to roughly 705,000 in May before falling below 45,000 by year end, according to Dune data summarized by Binance Research.
events.significance: STEPN became the defining move-to-earn boom-and-bust and one of 2022's clearest examples of token incentives driving consumer behavior.

sources.title: Dune — 22 Trends of 2022 / STEPN rise and fall

events.title: Azuki collection becomes a major NFT brand
events.summary: Azuki launched as a 10,000-item anime-inspired Ethereum PFP collection and framed itself around a community-built Web3/anime IP.
events.significance: Azuki became one of the defining non-Yuga PFP brands of the 2022 NFT market.

events.title: CFTC settles with Polymarket over event markets
events.summary: The CFTC announced a settlement with Blockratize, Inc., doing business as Polymarket.com, over off-exchange event-based binary options contracts.
events.significance: The action became Polymarket's first major US federal regulatory milestone and preceded its later mainstream growth.

events.title: Polymarket reaches settlement over unregistered markets
events.summary: The CFTC settled charges against Polymarket for offering off-exchange event-based binary options without required market registration, imposing a $1.4 million penalty and requiring non-compliant markets to be wound down.
events.significance: It was Polymarket's defining early US regulatory confrontation and shaped the platform's later market structure.

events.title: OpenSea valuation reaches more than ten billion dollars
events.summary: OpenSea announced a $300 million Series C financing at a $13.3 billion post-money valuation.
events.significance: The valuation captured the extraordinary market expectations around NFTs at the start of 2022.

events.title: LooksRare launches token incentives against OpenSea
events.summary: LooksRare launched with LOOKS token incentives targeted partly at active OpenSea users in what contemporary coverage described as a vampire attack.
events.significance: It was an early example of token incentives being used to attack a dominant NFT marketplace's liquidity and users.

sources.title: The Block — LooksRare launches with OpenSea vampire attack

events.title: Twitter adds NFT profile-picture verification
events.summary: Twitter launched verified NFT profile pictures for Twitter Blue subscribers on iOS on 20 January 2022, not in 2021.
events.significance: The hexagonal profile image made wallet-verified NFT ownership a native feature on a major social network.

sources.title: Reuters — Twitter launches NFT profile pictures

events.title: Meta sells Diem assets to Silvergate
events.summary: The Diem Association announced it was selling its intellectual property and other assets to Silvergate Capital after regulatory feedback made the planned US payment network unworkable.
events.significance: The sale ended Facebook/Meta's original private global-currency project and closed one of crypto policy's biggest corporate experiments.

events.title: Phantom becomes a major consumer Solana wallet
events.summary: Phantom said it had gained more than 2 million monthly active users in six months and launched its iOS wallet alongside a $109 million Series B.
events.significance: The milestone established Phantom as the dominant consumer gateway to the Solana ecosystem during its rapid growth.

sources.title: Phantom — $109M Series B and iOS launch

events.title: Wormhole bridge exploit
events.summary: The Wormhole bridge was exploited for 120,000 wrapped ETH, worth roughly $320 million at the time, after an attacker bypassed verification and minted unbacked assets.
events.significance: The exploit became one of the first mega-scale bridge failures and highlighted cross-chain verification as a systemic security risk.

events.title: US authorities seize Bitcoin linked to the 2016 Bitfinex hack
events.summary: US authorities announced the arrest of Ilya Lichtenstein and Heather Morgan and the seizure of more than $3.6 billion in Bitcoin linked to the 2016 Bitfinex hack.
events.significance: It was the Justice Department's largest financial seizure announced at the time and demonstrated how stolen Bitcoin could remain traceable years later.

sources.title: US DOJ — $3.6B crypto seizure linked to 2016 Bitfinex hack
US DOJ — 2016 Bitfinex Hack case summary

events.title: Coinbase bouncing QR-code Super Bowl ad crashes its app
events.summary: Coinbase aired a 60-second bouncing-QR-code Super Bowl ad that generated more than 20 million landing-page hits in one minute and forced the company to throttle traffic briefly.
events.significance: The minimalist ad became one of crypto's most memorable mainstream marketing moments and a perfect visual artifact of the bull-market peak.

sources.title: Coinbase — Everyone Wins at Super Bowl LVI — WAGMI!
Reuters — Coinbase traffic surge after Super Bowl ad

events.title: Dubai establishes VARA virtual-asset regulator
events.summary: Dubai issued Law No. 4 of 2022 establishing the Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) and a regulatory framework for virtual-asset activities across most of the Emirate.
events.significance: Dubai's dedicated regulator became a major part of the UAE's strategy to position itself as an international crypto hub.

sources.title: Dubai Law No. 4 of 2022 Regulating Virtual Assets

events.title: Crypto donations become a major part of fundraising for Ukraine
events.summary: Ukraine's government said official crypto-donation channels had helped raise more than $53 million by 3 March following Russia's invasion.
events.significance: The fundraising demonstrated cryptocurrency's ability to mobilize global cross-border donations quickly during a national emergency.

sources.title: Ukraine Cabinet — $53M crypto raised by Mar. 3

events.title: Yuga Labs buys CryptoPunks and Meebits rights
events.summary: Yuga Labs acquired the CryptoPunks and Meebits brands and related IP from Larva Labs and said it would grant commercial rights to holders.
events.significance: The deal consolidated two foundational NFT collections under the company behind Bored Ape Yacht Club.

sources.title: Yuga Labs — acquires CryptoPunks and Meebits IP

events.title: LayerZero launches omnichain messaging infrastructure
events.summary: LayerZero launched its omnichain interoperability protocol in beta across seven EVM networks.
events.significance: LayerZero became major cross-chain messaging infrastructure and formed the base layer for Stargate and later omnichain applications.

sources.title: LayerZero — The Omnichain Future is Here

events.title: Aave V3 launches
events.summary: Aave V3 launched across six networks with new capital-efficiency, risk-management and cross-chain-oriented features.
events.significance: V3 established Aave as a deliberately multichain lending protocol and introduced architecture that later supported much larger DeFi markets.

sources.title: Aave governance — Aave V3 deployment history

events.title: Stargate becomes a major LayerZero-based bridge and liquidity protocol
events.summary: Stargate Protocol launched two days after LayerZero, bootstrapping omnichain native-asset liquidity across connected networks.
events.significance: Stargate became one of the first major applications of LayerZero and a prominent cross-chain liquidity bridge.

sources.title: LayerZero — The Omnichain Future is Here

events.title: Ukraine sells NFT collection to fund war effort
events.summary: Ukraine's government launched Meta History: Museum of War, an NFT collection documenting the Russian invasion and raising funds for Ukraine.
events.significance: It joined crypto donations with state-backed digital cultural archiving and fundraising during wartime.

sources.title: Ukraine Cabinet — NFT Museum of War launch

events.title: Ronin Bridge loses 173,600 ETH and 25.5 million USDC
events.summary: Attackers drained 173,600 ETH and 25.5 million USDC from the Ronin Bridge. Sky Mavis later rebuilt the bridge and reimbursed user liabilities.
events.significance: The attack was one of the largest crypto thefts ever and exposed the security trade-offs of a validator-controlled bridge supporting a major blockchain game.

sources.title: Ronin — The Ronin Bridge Is Open

events.title: UK recognizes crypto assets in financial-services reform agenda
events.summary: HM Treasury announced plans to bring stablecoins within UK payments regulation and set out a wider ambition to make the UK a global cryptoasset technology hub.
events.significance: The announcement marked a major UK policy shift toward building a dedicated crypto regulatory framework rather than treating crypto only through existing rules.

sources.title: HM Treasury — plan to make UK a global cryptoasset technology hub

events.title: Hydra Market is shut down
events.summary: US and German authorities announced the seizure and shutdown of Hydra Market, with German police seizing servers and Bitcoin wallets.
events.significance: Hydra was described by US authorities as the world's largest and longest-running darknet marketplace at the time.

sources.title: US DOJ — shutdown of Hydra Market

events.title: Moonbirds mint generates enormous first-day volume
events.summary: Moonbirds minted on 16 April 2022 as a 10,000-item PROOF PFP collection; contemporary coverage reported roughly $200 million in sales within days of debut.
events.significance: Its explosive launch was one of the final spectacular PFP mints before the 2022 NFT downturn.

sources.title: CoinDesk — Moonbirds clocks $200M in debut sales
SEC-filed offering document citing Moonbirds Apr 16 launch

events.title: Beanstalk governance exploit drains protocol funds
events.summary: Beanstalk was attacked through its on-chain governance mechanism after an attacker used a flash loan to obtain enough voting power; the protocol says roughly $77 million in non-Bean assets were stolen.
events.significance: The exploit became a canonical demonstration that token governance itself can be an attack surface.

events.title: Coinbase NFT marketplace launches into cooling market
events.summary: Coinbase opened its NFT social marketplace in beta to its first users.
events.significance: The launch showed a major listed crypto exchange attempting to enter the NFT marketplace race near the top of the NFT cycle.

events.title: Central African Republic adopts Bitcoin as legal tender
events.summary: The Central African Republic enacted a law giving cryptocurrencies, and Bitcoin in particular, legal-tender status alongside the CFA franc.
events.significance: CAR became the second country after El Salvador to make Bitcoin legal tender and the first to do so while belonging to a monetary union.

sources.title: IMF — CEMAC staff report on CAR Bitcoin legal-tender law

events.title: Goblintown emerges as a free-mint bear-market NFT phenomenon
events.summary: Goblintown launched in May 2022 as an anonymous, free-mint NFT project with no roadmap or conventional utility pitch; it minted out rapidly and became a viral bear-market phenomenon.
events.significance: Goblintown inverted the polished 2021 NFT playbook and became defining absurdist bear-market LORE.

events.title: LUNA collapses in Terra's death spiral
events.summary: As UST lost its peg, the protocol's conversion mechanism expanded LUNA supply dramatically while market confidence collapsed.
events.significance: The destruction of the Terra ecosystem erased enormous market value and propagated losses into lenders, hedge funds and counterparties across crypto.

events.title: TerraUSD loses its dollar peg
events.summary: UST began materially departing from its $1 target during 7–8 May 2022. Terra and Luna Foundation Guard deployed reserves and market purchases in an attempt to restore the peg.
events.significance: The depeg broke confidence in the algorithmic stablecoin mechanism and triggered the LUNA death spiral that became the defining collapse of the first half of 2022.

sources.title: Terra Docs — pre-depeg snapshot and post-collapse chain history

events.title: Luna 2.0 launches after community vote
events.summary: A new Terra blockchain launched after governance approved a revival plan; the original network was renamed Terra Classic, and the new chain did not include the original UST stablecoin.
events.significance: The relaunch attempted to preserve the developer ecosystem after the stablecoin system had failed.

sources.title: Terra Research Forum — Ecosystem Revival Plan 2

events.title: Optimism airdrops OP token
events.summary: Optimism opened claims for its first OP governance-token airdrop to hundreds of thousands of eligible early Ethereum and Optimism users.
events.significance: The OP launch created the Token House side of the Optimism Collective and became a major layer-2 governance distribution.

events.title: Zcash Halo removes trusted setup dependence for newer pools
events.summary: Zcash activated Network Upgrade 5 (NU5), launching the Orchard shielded protocol and Halo 2 proving system and removing the need for trusted setup ceremonies for the new pool.
events.significance: NU5 was a major zero-knowledge cryptography milestone and improved the practicality and trust assumptions of Zcash privacy.

sources.title: Electric Coin Company — NU5 activates on mainnet

events.title: Celsius freezes customer withdrawals and transfers
events.summary: Celsius froze withdrawals and transfers for its roughly 1.7 million customers in June 2022, citing extreme market conditions, then filed for bankruptcy in July.
events.significance: The freeze turned crypto-credit stress into a retail bank-run-like crisis and became one of the defining failures of centralized yield lending.

events.title: Genesis exposure to Three Arrows weakens lending business
events.summary: The SEC later found that Three Arrows Capital defaulted on a Genesis margin call in mid-June 2022, contributing to an approximately $1 billion loss and compromising Genesis's business.
events.significance: The loss was a key hidden link between the 3AC failure and the later Genesis/DCG crisis.

sources.title: SEC — Genesis / DCG Three Arrows Capital loss findings

events.title: Coinbase lays off staff during crypto winter
events.summary: Coinbase announced a reduction of about 18% of its workforce, approximately 1,100 employees, amid changing market and economic conditions.
events.significance: The layoffs became a visible marker of the 2022 crypto winter reaching publicly listed crypto companies.

events.title: BlockFi receives FTX rescue facility
events.summary: FTX agreed to provide BlockFi a $250 million revolving credit facility, later followed by a larger definitive facility and purchase option.
events.significance: The facility is the concrete event behind the 'FTX rescue' narrative.

sources.title: BlockFi confirmed plan — FTX loan agreement

events.title: FTX offers rescue financing to troubled crypto firms
events.summary: BlockFi announced a term sheet with FTX for a $250 million revolving credit facility; a later June 30 agreement expanded the available FTX facility and included a purchase option.
events.significance: The rescue made FTX appear to be crypto's lender of last resort only months before FTX itself failed.

sources.title: BlockFi confirmed plan — FTX loan agreement

events.title: dYdX announces move toward its own Cosmos-based chain
events.summary: dYdX announced that version 4 would be developed as a standalone blockchain based on the Cosmos SDK and Tendermint proof-of-stake, with a decentralized off-chain order book and matching engine.
events.significance: The move was a major example of a successful Ethereum application choosing an app-specific sovereign chain for performance and decentralization.

sources.title: dYdX June 22 2022 V4 Cosmos announcement archive

events.title: Solana mobile Saga phone is announced
events.summary: Solana Mobile introduced Saga, an Android smartphone designed around self-custody, a Seed Vault and the Solana Mobile Stack.
events.significance: Saga was one of crypto's boldest attempts to build blockchain key management and dapp distribution directly into consumer hardware.

events.title: Harmony Horizon Bridge loses about $100 million
events.summary: Harmony's Horizon bridge was exploited, causing losses later quantified by the project at $99,340,030 across about 65,000 wallets and 14 asset types.
events.significance: The attack added to a devastating year for cross-chain bridges and reinforced concerns about concentrated bridge signing and custody designs.

events.title: Three Arrows Capital defaults on Voyager loans
events.summary: Voyager issued a notice of default to Three Arrows Capital after 3AC failed to repay 15,250 BTC and $350 million USDC.
events.significance: The default gave a concrete view of the enormous counterparty exposures connecting crypto hedge funds and retail lending platforms and directly preceded Voyager's bankruptcy.

events.title: Three Arrows Capital collapses
events.summary: Voyager declared Three Arrows Capital in default on loans of 15,250 BTC and $350 million USDC on 27 June; a British Virgin Islands court then ordered 3AC into liquidation.
events.significance: The failure of one of crypto's largest hedge funds exposed interconnected leverage and became a central transmission mechanism in the 2022 credit crisis.

sources.title: Washington Post — Three Arrows Capital ordered into liquidation

events.title: Arbitrum Odyssey overwhelms network demand
events.summary: Arbitrum paused its Odyssey incentive campaign after unusually high demand caused congestion and elevated transaction fees.
events.significance: The event showed that even a scaling network could be overwhelmed by incentive-driven user activity.

sources.title: The Block — Arbitrum pauses Odyssey after congestion

events.title: EU reaches political agreement on MiCA
events.summary: EU negotiators reached a provisional political agreement on the Markets in Crypto-Assets regulation (MiCA).
events.significance: MiCA established the basis for the EU's comprehensive cross-border crypto-asset regulatory framework.

sources.title: Council of EU — provisional MiCA agreement

events.title: 3AC founders disappear from public view during liquidation
events.summary: During Three Arrows Capital's liquidation, court-appointed representatives said they initially did not know the founders' whereabouts and had difficulty contacting them.
events.significance: The uncertainty turned a huge institutional default into an unusual global manhunt-style insolvency story.

sources.title: Washington Post — 3AC liquidators and founders' whereabouts

events.title: Uniswap governance debates a protocol fee-switch pilot
events.summary: Uniswap's formal governance push to test the protocol fee switch became a major debate in 2022, not 2021.
events.significance: The debate matters because protocol fees raise questions about DAO governance, LP economics and token value accrual.

sources.title: Uniswap Governance — fee switch design discussion

events.title: Voyager Digital files for Chapter 11
events.summary: Voyager filed for Chapter 11 after suspending platform activity and disclosed claims against Three Arrows Capital exceeding $650 million.
events.significance: Voyager demonstrated how leveraged counterparty exposure transmitted the 2022 hedge-fund crisis directly into retail crypto lending platforms.

events.title: Reddit quietly onboards mainstream users to blockchain collectibles
events.summary: Reddit announced blockchain-backed Collectible Avatars sold through a dedicated storefront and usable as Reddit profile imagery.
events.significance: Reddit quietly introduced millions of mainstream users to blockchain collectibles while often avoiding heavy 'NFT' terminology.

events.title: Safe spins out as major smart-account infrastructure
events.summary: Gnosis Safe announced its rebrand to Safe and a $100 million strategic raise as it developed into independent smart-account infrastructure.
events.significance: The spinout/rebrand marked Safe's transition from Gnosis product to foundational multi-signature and smart-account infrastructure.

events.title: OpenSea cuts staff as NFT market contracts
events.summary: OpenSea cut about 20% of its staff as NFT trading activity and the broader crypto market contracted.
events.significance: The layoffs became a clear operating-company marker of the NFT boom turning into crypto winter.

events.title: Nomad bridge exploit becomes a copycat free-for-all
events.summary: A configuration error in Nomad's bridge allowed attackers to replay a successful withdrawal message; more than 300 addresses copied transactions and over $186 million was removed.
events.significance: Nomad became crypto's most literal 'copy-paste' hack, with opportunistic addresses joining the exploit after the flaw became obvious.

sources.title: Nomad — Nomad Bridge Hack: Root Cause Analysis

events.title: Tiffany launches CryptoPunk-linked NFTiff jewelry
events.summary: Tiffany announced NFTiff: 250 passes for CryptoPunk owners to redeem for custom jewel pendants and matching digital renders, with sales beginning in early August.
events.significance: NFTiff became one of the clearest luxury-brand attempts to fuse a major NFT collection with high-end physical goods.

events.title: BlackRock partners with Coinbase for institutional crypto access
events.summary: Coinbase announced a partnership with BlackRock connecting Coinbase Prime with BlackRock's Aladdin platform, initially giving mutual institutional clients direct access to Bitcoin trading and custody.
events.significance: The deal linked one of traditional finance's most important institutional platforms with crypto prime brokerage and custody.

sources.title: Coinbase — selected by BlackRock for Aladdin crypto access

events.title: US Treasury sanctions Tornado Cash
events.summary: The US Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctioned Tornado Cash, an Ethereum-based virtual-currency mixer.
events.significance: The action triggered a major legal and philosophical conflict over financial privacy, sanctions, decentralized smart contracts and whether immutable code can be treated as a sanctionable entity.

events.title: Tornado Cash developer arrest intensifies privacy debate
events.summary: Dutch FIOD arrested a 29-year-old Tornado Cash developer in Amsterdam on suspicion of involvement in concealing criminal financial flows and facilitating money laundering; he was later identified publicly as Alexey Pertsev.
events.significance: The arrest intensified the debate over developer liability, privacy software and decentralized protocols immediately after US sanctions on Tornado Cash.

sources.title: Dutch FIOD — arrest of suspected Tornado Cash developer

events.notes: State suspicions/allegations as those of Dutch authorities, not as independent conclusions.

events.title: ENS registrations surge during Web3 identity boom
events.summary: ENS crossed 2 million registered .eth names on 17 August 2022.
events.significance: The milestone showed decentralized naming becoming one of Ethereum's most widely adopted identity applications during the Web3 boom.

events.title: Starbucks announces Odyssey NFT loyalty experiment
events.summary: Starbucks announced Starbucks Odyssey, a Web3 extension of Starbucks Rewards using Polygon and NFT-based digital collectible 'journey stamps.'
events.significance: The project was a major mainstream consumer-brand experiment in using NFTs as loyalty infrastructure rather than profile pictures.

events.title: South Korean court issues arrest warrant for Do Kwon
events.summary: A South Korean court issued arrest warrants for Do Kwon and five others after the Terra collapse; Kwon was believed to be in Singapore at the time.
events.significance: The warrant transformed Terra's collapse from a market failure into a cross-border criminal-investigation story.

sources.title: Reuters — South Korea arrest warrant for Do Kwon

events.title: Flashbots MEV-Boost becomes important after Ethereum Merge
events.summary: Flashbots MEV-Boost went live with proof-of-stake Ethereum at The Merge; Flashbots recorded the first PoS block proposed through MEV-Boost shortly afterward.
events.significance: MEV-Boost rapidly became core post-Merge block-building infrastructure and made proposer-builder separation an operational reality.

sources.title: Flashbots — MEV-Boost status update after Merge

events.title: Ethereum completes The Merge
events.summary: Ethereum's Paris upgrade switched mainnet consensus from proof of work to proof of stake at block 15,537,394.
events.significance: The Merge ended Ethereum mining, integrated the Beacon Chain into mainnet consensus and reduced Ethereum's estimated energy consumption by about 99.95%.

events.title: Kraken CEO Jesse Powell steps down
events.summary: Kraken announced that COO Dave Ripley would succeed co-founder Jesse Powell as CEO after a COO replacement was found, with Powell moving to chairman.
events.significance: The succession marked a leadership transition at one of crypto's oldest surviving exchanges.

events.title: Cardano Vasil upgrade improves smart-contract capabilities
events.summary: Cardano activated the Vasil hard fork, moving into the Babbage era with changes intended to improve throughput, Plutus smart-contract efficiency and scaling.
events.significance: Vasil was one of Cardano's largest post-smart-contract protocol upgrades.

events.title: Helium community votes to migrate to Solana
events.summary: Helium's HIP 70 governance vote passed with 81.41% of voting power, approving migration of Helium's tokens, governance and transaction/account layer from its own L1 to Solana.
events.significance: It was an unusual decision by a live blockchain ecosystem to abandon its sovereign base chain in favor of another network.

sources.title: Helium Vote — HIP 70 Scaling the Network

events.title: Interpol Red Notice is reported in Do Kwon case
events.summary: South Korean prosecutors said Interpol had issued a Red Notice for Do Kwon, requesting law-enforcement agencies worldwide locate and provisionally arrest him.
events.significance: The Red Notice made the Terra founder's location and extradition an international crypto-crime story.

sources.title: Yonhap — Interpol Red Notice for Do Kwon

events.title: BNB Chain bridge exploit mints roughly 2 million BNB
events.summary: An attacker exploited the BSC Token Hub cross-chain bridge and withdrew roughly 2 million newly minted BNB. Validators temporarily halted BNB Smart Chain while the incident was contained.
events.significance: The event became a major bridge-security and governance case because validators coordinated a temporary chain halt to limit losses.

events.title: Devcon Bogota marks return of major in-person Ethereum conference
events.summary: Ethereum Foundation's Devcon VI took place in Bogotá, Colombia, reuniting the main Devcon conference in person after a three-year gap.
events.significance: The return marked the post-pandemic reopening of Ethereum's flagship global developer gathering and a deliberate expansion into Latin America.

sources.title: Ethereum Foundation — Devcon VI in Bogotá

events.title: Aptos mainnet launches
events.summary: Aptos Labs announced that Aptos Mainnet had arrived after years of development by a team that included former Diem engineers.
events.significance: Aptos became a major Move-based layer-1 launch and one of the most heavily funded new-chain debuts of the post-2021 cycle.

sources.title: Aptos Labs — Aptos Autumn is Here

events.title: Blur launches and challenges OpenSea
events.summary: Blur launched publicly after a four-month private beta, using 'care package' airdrop incentives for NFT traders and listings.
events.significance: Blur introduced a pro-trader, incentive-heavy marketplace model that became OpenSea's strongest volume competitor.

sources.title: The Block — Blur marketplace goes live

events.title: CoinDesk reveals Alameda's FTT-heavy balance sheet
events.summary: CoinDesk reported on a private Alameda Research balance sheet showing $14.6 billion of assets at June 30, with a large concentration in FTX-issued FTT and related tokens.
events.significance: The report punctured confidence in the separation and financial strength of Alameda and FTX and became the immediate public catalyst for the exchange's final crisis.

events.title: FTX suffers a rapid liquidity crisis and customer run
events.summary: Following the Alameda balance-sheet report, Binance said it would sell its FTT holdings, confidence collapsed, FTT fell sharply and customers rushed to withdraw assets from FTX.
events.significance: Within days, one of the world's largest crypto exchanges moved from apparent strength to insolvency, demonstrating the speed of a digital bank run.

sources.title: CoinDesk — FTT collapse during FTX crisis

events.title: FTX files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
events.summary: FTX Trading and dozens of affiliates filed Chapter 11 petitions on 11 November 2022; Sam Bankman-Fried resigned as CEO and John J. Ray III took over restructuring.
events.significance: FTX's collapse became the defining exchange failure of the modern crypto era and triggered losses, investigations, bankruptcies and a global regulatory response.

events.title: Gemini Earn freezes withdrawals through Genesis exposure
events.summary: After Genesis Global Capital paused withdrawals, Gemini said the Earn program could no longer meet its five-business-day redemption SLA and paused Earn withdrawals.
events.significance: The freeze showed FTX contagion spreading through Genesis into a major consumer exchange product.

events.title: Genesis suspends redemptions in lending business
events.summary: Genesis Global Capital suspended new loan originations and redemptions after the FTX failure created what it described as abnormal withdrawal requests exceeding liquidity.
events.significance: The suspension showed FTX contagion reaching institutional crypto lending and later fed into Genesis's own bankruptcy.

events.title: BlockFi files for bankruptcy after FTX collapse
events.summary: BlockFi filed for Chapter 11 on 28 November after pausing withdrawals during FTX's collapse; BlockFi had previously received rescue financing from FTX.
events.significance: The bankruptcy showed how FTX's failure propagated through firms that had survived the earlier Terra/3AC shock only by relying on FTX itself.

events.title: Sam Bankman-Fried is arrested in the Bahamas
events.summary: Bahamian authorities arrested Sam Bankman-Fried on 12 December at the request of US prosecutors; an eight-count federal indictment was unsealed the next day.
events.significance: The arrest transformed the FTX collapse from a corporate bankruptcy story into one of the largest criminal fraud cases in financial history.

sources.title: US DOJ — SBF indictment and arrest

events.title: Core Scientific enters Chapter 11
events.summary: Core Scientific and certain affiliates filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions while continuing to operate as debtors in possession.
events.significance: The bankruptcy became the clearest corporate failure of the debt-funded public Bitcoin-mining expansion.

events.title: SBF extradited to the United States
events.summary: Sam Bankman-Fried was extradited from the Bahamas to the United States on 21 December 2022, not in 2023.
events.significance: The extradition brought the FTX founder into US federal custody ahead of the 2023 criminal trial.

sources.title: DOJ — SBF extradited to the United States

events.title: BONK airdrop helps energize Solana ecosystem
events.summary: BONK launched on Christmas Day 2022, with more than half of its supply distributed to developers and creators across the Solana ecosystem.
events.significance: The community distribution arrived immediately after the FTX shock and became an important morale and meme-culture catalyst for Solana's recovery.

events.title: Coinbase introduces subscription-based Coinbase One
events.summary: Coinbase said it began testing Coinbase One in early 2022 as a subscription product offering US retail users zero trading fees, enhanced support and other benefits for a monthly fee.
events.significance: Coinbase One represented a shift from purely transaction-fee monetization toward subscription revenue.

sources.title: Coinbase Q2 2022 shareholder letter — Coinbase One beta
